blind.description: A classical stone pedestal consisting of a stepped square base, a panelled vertical pillar, a widened octagonal capital, and four green stone prongs or claws cradling a large spherical stone orb. The surfaces are continuous, solid, and cleanly textured with weathered beige-brown stone. The base sits flat on the ground with no floating parts, melted meshes, or glowing effects.
blind.from_above: A circular stone sphere centered inside an octagonal basin rim with four small green holding prongs at cardinal points, set over a square stepped base.
blind.height_vs_figure: About half the height of the figure (around 3 feet tall), with a base width of roughly 1.5 feet.
